titulo: My Grandma Had One Rule About the Basement #Shorts
titulo_pt: Minha avó tinha uma regra sobre o porão
descricao:
She told me never to answer. I finally understand why.

Would you answer? Tell me below.

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: My grandma had one rule. Never answer if someone calls your name from the basement.
scenes.visual: old wooden basement door slightly open in a dark farmhouse hallway, faint light under the door
scenes.pt: Minha avó tinha uma regra. Nunca responda se alguém chamar seu nome do porão.

scenes.text: I thought it was a joke. Until the night she died.
scenes.visual: elderly woman's empty rocking chair in a dim living room at night, old family photos on the wall
scenes.pt: Eu achava que era brincadeira. Até a noite em que ela morreu.

scenes.text: I was alone in her house, packing up her things.
scenes.visual: young woman packing cardboard boxes alone in an old house at night, single lamp
scenes.pt: Eu estava sozinha na casa dela, empacotando as coisas.

scenes.text: At three a.m., I heard it.
scenes.visual: dark staircase going down into a pitch black basement, view from the top
scenes.pt: Às três da manhã, eu ouvi.

scenes.text: It was her voice. Perfectly her voice.
scenes.visual: close-up of a frightened young woman's face in darkness, eyes wide, lit by moonlight
scenes.pt: Era a voz dela. Perfeitamente a voz dela.

scenes.text: I almost answered. Then my phone lit up.
scenes.visual: smartphone screen glowing on a nightstand in a dark bedroom
scenes.pt: Quase respondi. Aí meu celular acendeu.

scenes.text: A text message. From my grandma's number.
scenes.visual: close-up of a hand holding a glowing phone in the dark, face out of focus
scenes.pt: Uma mensagem. Do número da minha avó.

scenes.text: Don't go down there. I'm upstairs with you.
scenes.visual: dark upstairs hallway of an old house, a bedroom door at the end slowly opening
scenes.pt: Não desce. Eu tô aqui em cima com você.

scenes.text: I looked up. Her bedroom door was open.
scenes.visual: old bedroom doorway open in darkness, a faint silhouette standing inside
scenes.pt: Olhei pra cima. A porta do quarto dela estava aberta.

scenes.text: Then, from the basement, a whisper.
scenes.visual: pitch black basement with a pale hand resting on the bottom step of the stairs

scenes.text: I never answered either of them. They both still call my name.
scenes.visual: young woman sitting on the floor of a dark hallway between the stairs, hugging her knees, terrified
scenes.pt: Nunca respondi nenhuma das duas. As duas ainda chamam meu nome.

scenes.visual: split view of a dark basement door and a dark bedroom door in an old house

resumo_pt: Uma neta passa a noite na casa da avó que acabou de morrer. Uma voz igual à da avó a chama do porão, e ao mesmo tempo chega uma mensagem do celular da avó dizendo que ela está lá em cima. A voz do porão sussurra: "ela está mentindo".
